curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: subtract a 1-digit number from a 2-digit number without regrouping

mission.title: subtract a 1-digit number from a 2-digit number without regrouping

interactions.prompt: There are 12 mangoes. Amina gives away 2 mangoes. How many mangoes are left?
interactions.retryHint: Start at 12 and count back two steps: 11, 10.

interactions.prompt: Show 23 counters: 2 tens and 3 ones. Take away 2 ones. Tap the number left.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap two ones to move them away, then tap the number left.
interactions.feedback: Great! The 2 tens stay. 3 ones take away 2 ones leaves 1 one: 21.
interactions.retryHint: Do not touch the tens. Count the ones left after taking away two.

interactions.prompt: Build the sentence for 34 take away 3.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the cards in the order of the subtraction sentence.
interactions.feedback: Well done! 34 − 3 = 31. The 3 tens did not change.
interactions.retryHint: Take 3 from the 4 ones. There is 1 one left.

interactions.prompt: A shop has 46 oranges. It sells 4 oranges. How many oranges are left?
interactions.retryHint: Keep the 4 tens. Take 4 from the 6 ones.

interactions.prompt: At the library, 38 books are on a shelf. 5 books are borrowed. Move away 5 ones, then choose the number left.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap five one-counters to move them away, then tap the answer.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! 38 − 5 = 33. The 3 tens stay the same.
interactions.retryHint: Eight ones take away five ones leaves three ones.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. 27 seedlings are ready to plant. 6 are planted. How many seedlings are left?
interactions.retryHint: Keep 2 tens. Take 6 from 7 ones, leaving 1 one.
